proposal.inferred_root_cause: PSP degradation on the card path for card:icici at 4% success over 214 attempts
proposal.reasoning_trace: card:icici is effectively down at 4% success over 214 attempts against a 90% baseline, with the breaker already half-open, and the only open notice names card:kkbk, a different issuer on the same method. The code names the gateway layer and the collapse is confined to this path, so the fault is between the mesh and the issuer rather than at the issuer. The open notice on card:kkbk is a different issuer and explains nothing here. Attempt 2 failing identically rules out a one-off switch error. No session is open, so recovery is a scheduling problem: retry on card after 8m, which is how long gateway faults of this shape usually take to clear.
